preserved_failure_and_resolution.mass_sheet: An additional probe on the 375-test frozen library found that upper-left M^2 with PlusI0 followed a different sheet from the principal radial formula. For the six-line three-loop scalar the ratio was exp(6*pi*i*epsilon), checked at epsilon=1/10 with scaled residual 2.4055719876e-57. Raised powers shared the phase, so checking the mass derivative alone would not detect it.
preserved_failure_and_resolution.resolution: Retain exact mass constraints in PreparedFlow; reject uncertified Re(M^2)<=0, Im(M^2)>0 with PlusI0 and the conjugate MinusI0 case in the recognized class. Do not silently reverse the prescription or substitute a topology-specific terminal result for transport.
preserved_failure_and_resolution.zero_precedence: Read-only review found a conservative rejection of the certified-zero sector [1,1,0] in [q^2-M^2,l^2,(q-l)^2]. The preserved pre-fix probe has native_scaleless=true and one retained constraint. The final implementation skips that constraint only after the existing native ProvedZero certificate.
